configuration:
seed: 42
output_dir: <local path>
study: panel_mean5_seed42
data:
  root: <local path>
  train_manifest: <local path>
  val_manifest: val_dataframe.csv
  test_manifest: test_dataframe.csv
  crop_size: 256
  channels: &id001
  - 0
  - 2
  - 13
  - 15
  - 16
  workers: 8
  persistent_workers: true
  timeout: 300
  discovery_manifest: <local path>
model:
  name: panel_unet
  panel: *id001
  probe: false
  base_channels: 48
loss:
  l1: 0.5
  charbonnier: 0.5
  charbonnier_epsilon: 0.001
  multiscale: 0.25
  multiscale_scales:
  - 0.5
  - 0.25
  perceptual: 0.05
validation:
  lpips: true
  selection_metric: lpips
  save_best_psnr: true
  constraints: {}
  early_stopping:
    enabled: false
train:
  max_steps: 80000
  batch_size: 8
  lr: 0.0001
  amp: bf16
  warmup_steps: 500
  l1_priming_steps: 60000
  validate_every: 4000
  checkpoint_every: 1000
  log_every: 50
  grad_clip: 1.0
  validate_initial: false
  max_seconds: 10500
purpose: Scratch 80k; only declared stains; exact common U-Net capacity; final-step primary; waits for gated discovery
time_definition: Historical Slurm training-job elapsed time. Includes setup, validation and I/O; excludes separate pretraining, parent runs and other continuation allocations.
